title: [C16T2] The production of sugar from sugar cane
prompt: The diagram shows the manufacturing process for making sugar from sugar cane. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagram illustrates the steps involved in manufacturing sugar from sugar cane plants.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: The process consists of seven main stages which transform raw sugar cane into refined sugar crystals, beginning with growing sugar cane and ending with drying and cooling the final product.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: The process starts when sugar cane is grown over a period of 12 to 18 months. Once mature, the canes are harvested using both mechanical equipment and manual labor. The harvested canes then undergo crushing, during which juice is extracted using large rollers.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: The remaining steps focus on refining the juice into pure sugar. First, the juice passes through a limestone filter for purification, after which it enters an evaporator where heat is applied to turn it into syrup. This syrup is then processed in a centrifuge to separate sugar crystals from the remaining liquid. Finally, these crystals undergo drying and cooling to produce the finished sugar product.
